ops.title: Five guards pin the MCP tool surface, not two — the full list for anyone adding a tool

ops.body:
## Correction

Planning material in this repo states that adding an MCP tool trips two
machine-enforced guards and that `CC_NOTES_TOOLS` in
`plugin/capt-hook/hooks/common.py` is hand-mirrored, so a new tool can silently
drop out of the hook pack's approval/redirect map.

**That is false on both counts.** There are five guards, `CC_NOTES_TOOLS` is one
of the things they machine-enforce (in both directions, since 2026-07-16), and
two more guards the two-guard story never mentions also fire.

Measured 2026-07-27 by adding four real tools (`task_link`, `task_unlink`,
`investigation_follow_up`, `investigation_supersede`). Three of the five went
red; all five are listed here so the next agent budgets for them.

| # | Guard | What it pins | Fired on a new tool? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `internal/mcpserver/inventory_test.go:121` `TestMCPVocabularyMatchesCobra` | every tool's synthesized argv is vocabulary the cobra tree accepts | no (argv was valid) |
| 2 | `internal/mcpserver/reverse_test.go:231` `TestCobraReachableFromMCP` | every runnable CLI leaf and local flag is reachable from some MCP tool | no (schema fields added with the flags) |
| 3 | `internal/mcpserver/redirect_inventory_test.go:71` `TestPackInventoryMatchesRegistry` | **`CC_NOTES_TOOLS` == the live registry, both directions** | **YES** |
| 4 | `internal/mcpserver/docs_test.go:156` `TestMCPReferenceMatchesRegistry` | every tool is named by an `MCP: ` line in `plugin/skills/using-cc-notes/references/cli-reference.md`, both directions | **YES** |
| 5 | `internal/mcpserver/server_test.go:539` `TestListToolsInventory` | a hand-pinned `const wantCount` of registered tools | **YES** |

Guard 3's filename is why the two-guard belief persists: it reads as "redirect"
rather than "inventory", so a recon pass grepping for inventory-shaped filenames
misses it. Guards 4 and 5 live in files named for docs and the server.

## Checklist for adding an MCP tool

1. Register it in `internal/mcpserver/tools_*.go`.
2. Add its name to `CC_NOTES_TOOLS` in `plugin/capt-hook/hooks/common.py` (guard 3).
3. Add an `MCP: <name> (arg, arg)` line to
   `plugin/skills/using-cc-notes/references/cli-reference.md` (guard 4).
4. Bump `const wantCount` in `internal/mcpserver/server_test.go` (guard 5).
5. Regenerate `internal/cli/testdata/vocabulary.golden` with
   `go test ./internal/cli -run Golden -update` if the tool added CLI surface.

## How guard 3 works

`inventoryToolSet` (redirect_inventory_test.go:25) reads
`plugin/capt-hook/hooks/common.py`, finds `CC_NOTES_TOOLS = frozenset(`, then
**brace-balances** from the following `{` to its matching `}` so it windows to
exactly that set literal — no other string literal in the module
(`CC_NOTES_EXECUTABLES`, `WRAPPER_EXECUTABLES`, shell-word sets) can leak in.
Inside that window it lifts every `"([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)"` match; comments
in the block carry no quotes, so prose is never mistaken for a tool name. It
then diffs that set against `ListTools` over a live in-memory MCP session built
on the neutered cobra root, and errors per name in both directions.

Introduced by 3e2753b (2026-07-16); retargeted onto `common.py` by 64417ec
(2026-07-20).

## Proof

Synthetic probe, 2026-07-26 — reverse (dropped `"task_renew"`) then forward
(added a bogus `"task_teleport"`):

```
--- FAIL: TestPackInventoryMatchesRegistry (0.20s)
    redirect_inventory_test.go:113: registered MCP tool "task_renew" is absent from plugin/capt-hook/hooks/common.py CC_NOTES_TOOLS
--- FAIL: TestPackInventoryMatchesRegistry (0.15s)
    redirect_inventory_test.go:101: plugin/capt-hook/hooks/common.py CC_NOTES_TOOLS names "task_teleport", which is not a registered MCP tool
```

Real additions, 2026-07-27 — guard 3 red before the `CC_NOTES_TOOLS` entries:

```
--- FAIL: TestPackInventoryMatchesRegistry (0.14s)
    redirect_inventory_test.go:113: registered MCP tool "investigation_follow_up" is absent from plugin/capt-hook/hooks/common.py CC_NOTES_TOOLS
    redirect_inventory_test.go:113: registered MCP tool "investigation_supersede" is absent from plugin/capt-hook/hooks/common.py CC_NOTES_TOOLS
    redirect_inventory_test.go:113: registered MCP tool "task_link" is absent from plugin/capt-hook/hooks/common.py CC_NOTES_TOOLS
    redirect_inventory_test.go:113: registered MCP tool "task_unlink" is absent from plugin/capt-hook/hooks/common.py CC_NOTES_TOOLS
```

Guards 4 and 5 red in the same run:

```
--- FAIL: TestMCPReferenceMatchesRegistry (0.19s)
    docs_test.go:156: registered MCP tool "investigation_follow_up" is named by no "MCP: " line in plugin/skills/using-cc-notes/references/cli-reference.md
    (…three more…)
--- FAIL: TestListToolsInventory (0.42s)
    server_test.go:503: tool count = 128, want 124
```

All five green after steps 2–4.

## Do not build a sixth guard

A `cc-notes mcp --list-tools` flag plus a plugin-side Python equality test was
proposed and rejected: the flag would have no consumer (STYLEGUIDE §1, §5), and
a Python test would duplicate a deterministic in-process Go test with one that
depends on a built binary — `capt-hook pack test plugin` runs in CI with no Go
toolchain. Source-tree pinning is the right granularity, since the pack and the
binary ship from the same repo and the same release.
